description: My Property Box are delighted to offer for rent this one double bedroom student property on Northumberland Street located directly opposite Fenwick's Department Store, just moments away from the universities. Northumberland Street is close to bus, metro and rail links into other areas. The property is well presented and accommodation comprises; communal entrance with security video entry & private mail boxes, reception hallway, lounge, kitchen, flat screen TV in lounge and bedroom. The property is quadruple glazed with modern interior. Kitchen has dishwasher, washer/ dryer, electric hob and oven, electric heating. Call My Property Box today to arrange a viewing.
